subject: physics
content: A heat engine operates between a cold reservoir at temperature T<sub>2</sub> = 400 K and a hot reservoir at temperature T<sub>1</sub>. It takes 300 J of heat from the hot reservoir and delivers 240 J of heat to the cold reservoir in a cycle. The minimum temperature of the hot reservoir has to be ______________ K.
